# RT-GSFit data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `python -m rtgsfit write-data-dictionary`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every quantity that RT-GSFit stores, in MDSplus (tree `RTGSFIT`, below the run node) and in
local files. The C name is the name of the compiled-in preshot constant.
Dimensions are in C/Python order (row-major, last axis fastest); MATLAB and MDSplus TDI see
the axes in reverse order. `SIZES.N_R` means `PRESHOT.SIZES:N_R`; `COIL` also refers to
`PRESHOT.COIL`. See [manual.md](manual.md) for the definitions of the symbols.

## Sizes

| Size | Description |
|---|---|
| `N_R` | Number of grid points in R |
| `N_Z` | Number of grid points in Z |
| `N_GRID` | Number of grid points, N_R * N_Z |
| `N_EDGE` | Number of grid points on the edge of the grid, 2 N_R + 2 N_Z - 4 |
| `N_LIMITER` | Number of limiter points |
| `N_COIL` | Number of PF coil circuits |
| `N_MAG_SIGNAL` | Number of PCS magnetic input signals |
| `N_FLUX_LOOP` | Number of flux loop constraints |
| `N_BP_PROBE` | Number of Bp probe constraints |
| `N_ROGOWSKI` | Number of Rogowski coil constraints |
| `N_CONSTRAINT` | Number of constraints, N_FLUX_LOOP + N_BP_PROBE + N_ROGOWSKI |
| `N_REG` | Number of regularisation rows of the least-squares problem |
| `N_FIT_TARGET` | Number of rows of the least-squares problem, N_CONSTRAINT + N_REG |
| `N_PLASMA` | Number of plasma degrees of freedom |
| `N_PASSIVE` | Number of passive-structure degrees of freedom |
| `N_FIT_DOF` | Number of unknowns of the least-squares problem, N_PLASMA + N_PASSIVE |
| `N_XPT_MAX` | Maximum number of x-points that are stored |
| `N_COIL_SIGNAL` | Number of PCS coil signals (Python only) |
| `N_INTERP` | 4, the points of a bilinear interpolation stencil |
| `N_R_PLUS_2` | N_R + 2 |
| `N_OUTLINE` | Number of points stored for the boundary outline (Python only) |
| `N_LEG` | Number of points stored for each SOL and SEC_XPT contour (Python only) |
| `N_TIMING` | Number of timed sections of `rtgsfit()` |

## Preshot

### `PRESHOT.GRID`

The computational grid.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.GRID:R` | `GRID_R` | `(SIZES.N_R)` | float64 | metre | Major radius of the grid columns |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:Z` | `GRID_Z` | `(SIZES.N_Z)` | float64 | metre | Height of the grid rows |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:D_R` | `GRID_D_R` | scalar | float64 | metre | Grid spacing in R |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:D_Z` | `GRID_D_Z` | scalar | float64 | metre | Grid spacing in Z |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:R_FLAT` | `GRID_R_FLAT` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | metre | R of every grid point; index i_z * N_R + i_r |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:Z_FLAT` | `GRID_Z_FLAT` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | metre | Z of every grid point; index i_z * N_R + i_r |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:INV_R` | `GRID_INV_R` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | 1 / metre | 1 / R; FF_PRIME_MU0 fits FF-prime / mu0 |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:MASK_LIMITER` | `GRID_MASK_LIMITER` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | int32 | dimensionless | Fixed geometry mask: 1 where plasma current is allowed; 0 in excluded regions |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:G_COIL` | `GRID_G_COIL` | `(SIZES.N_GRID, SIZES.N_COIL)` | float64 | weber / ampere | Greens function: psi on the grid per unit coil current |
| `PRESHOT.GRID:G_PASSIVE` | `GRID_G_PASSIVE` | `(SIZES.N_GRID, SIZES.N_PASSIVE)` | float64 | weber / ampere | Greens function: psi on the grid per unit passive degree of freedom |

### `PRESHOT.EDGE`

The edge of the grid, for the free-boundary condition.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.EDGE:R` | `EDGE_R` | `(SIZES.N_EDGE)` | float64 | metre | R of the grid edge points: from the bottom-left corner up, then clockwise in (R, Z) |
| `PRESHOT.EDGE:Z` | `EDGE_Z` | `(SIZES.N_EDGE)` | float64 | metre | Z of the grid edge points |
| `PRESHOT.EDGE:INV_MU0_R` | `EDGE_INV_MU0_R` | `(SIZES.N_EDGE)` | float64 | 1 / henry | 1 / (mu0 R) at the edge points |
| `PRESHOT.EDGE:G_EDGE` | `EDGE_G_EDGE` | `(SIZES.N_EDGE, SIZES.N_EDGE)` | float64 | weber / ampere | Edge flux response for the free-boundary condition: target rows, source columns |

### `PRESHOT.LIMITER`

The limiter.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.LIMITER:R` | `LIMITER_R` | `(SIZES.N_LIMITER)` | float64 | metre | R of the limiter points |
| `PRESHOT.LIMITER:Z` | `LIMITER_Z` | `(SIZES.N_LIMITER)` | float64 | metre | Z of the limiter points |
| `PRESHOT.LIMITER:GRID_INDEX` | `LIMITER_GRID_INDEX` | `(SIZES.N_LIMITER, 4)` | int32 | dimensionless | Grid indices of the bilinear interpolation stencil of each limiter point |
| `PRESHOT.LIMITER:GRID_WEIGHT` | `LIMITER_GRID_WEIGHT` | `(SIZES.N_LIMITER, 4)` | float64 | dimensionless | Bilinear interpolation weights of each limiter point |

### `PRESHOT.POISSON`

The discrete Grad-Shafranov operator.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.POISSON:RHS_SCALE` | `POISSON_RHS_SCALE` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | henry * metre ** 2 | (2 pi / INFO:PSI_TO_WB) mu0 R d_z^2; discrete rhs = -RHS_SCALE j_phi |
| `PRESHOT.POISSON:LOWER_BAND` | `POISSON_LOWER_BAND` | `(SIZES.N_GRID, SIZES.N_R)` | float64 | dimensionless | Lower band of the LU factors of the discrete Grad-Shafranov operator |
| `PRESHOT.POISSON:UPPER_BAND` | `POISSON_UPPER_BAND` | `(SIZES.N_GRID, SIZES.N_R + 2)` | float64 | dimensionless | Upper band of the LU factors; the diagonal (column 0) is stored inverted |
| `PRESHOT.POISSON:PERMUTATION` | `POISSON_PERMUTATION` | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | int32 | dimensionless | Row permutation of the LU factorisation |

### `PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT`

Magnetic signals, sensor replacement and coil response.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT:NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_CONSTRAINT)` | str | dimensionless | Constraint names: flux loops, then Bp probes, then Rogowski coils |
| `PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT:G_COIL` | `CONSTRAINT_G_COIL` | `(SIZES.N_CONSTRAINT, SIZES.N_COIL)` | float64 | mixed | Greens function: constraint value per unit coil current |
| `PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT:REPLACEMENT` | `CONSTRAINT_REPLACEMENT` | `(SIZES.N_CONSTRAINT, SIZES.N_MAG_SIGNAL)` | float64 | dimensionless | Maps mag_signal to measured constraints; a faulty sensor can use a combination of signals |
| `PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT:MAG_SIGNALS` |  | `(SIZES.N_MAG_SIGNAL)` | str | dimensionless | PCS magnetic signal names in REPLACEMENT column order |

### `PRESHOT.FIT`

The weighted least-squares problem fit_matrix fit_dof = fit_target.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.FIT:TARGET_NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | str | dimensionless | Names of the rows of fit_target: constraints, then regularisations |
| `PRESHOT.FIT:DOF_NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_DOF)` | str | dimensionless | Names of the entries of fit_dof: plasma, then passive degrees of freedom |
| `PRESHOT.FIT:DOF_UNITS` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_DOF)` | str | dimensionless | Physical units of each fitted plasma or passive DOF |
| `PRESHOT.FIT:WEIGHT` | `FIT_WEIGHT` | `(SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | float64 | mixed | Constraint weights (1 / uncertainty), followed by regularisation weights |
| `PRESHOT.FIT:G_GRID` | `FIT_G_GRID` | `(SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET, SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | dimensionless | Greens function: weighted fit_target per unit j_phi in each grid cell, including d_r d_z |
| `PRESHOT.FIT:G_PASSIVE` | `FIT_G_PASSIVE` | `(SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET, SIZES.N_PASSIVE)` | float64 | dimensionless | Greens function: weighted fit_target per unit passive DOF; the passive columns of fit_matrix |

### `PRESHOT.SETTINGS`

Scalar algorithm settings.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.SETTINGS:XPT_FRACTION` | `SETTINGS_XPT_FRACTION` | scalar | float64 | dimensionless | boundary_psi = XPT_FRACTION xpt_psi[0] + (1 - XPT_FRACTION) axis_psi when diverted |
| `PRESHOT.SETTINGS:TOLERANCE` | `SETTINGS_TOLERANCE` | scalar | float64 | dimensionless | Tolerance of the null finder and of boundary_psi == axis_psi |
| `PRESHOT.SETTINGS:IP_MIN` | `SETTINGS_IP_MIN` | scalar | float64 | ampere | Smallest ip for which the current centroid is computed |

### `PRESHOT.COIL`

PF coil circuits and the coil matrix that makes their currents from coil_signal.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.COIL:NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_COIL)` | str | dimensionless | PF coil circuit names |
| `PRESHOT.COIL:COIL_SIGNALS` |  | `(len(COIL:COIL_SIGNALS))` | str | dimensionless | PCS coil signal names in MATRIX row order |
| `PRESHOT.COIL:MATRIX` |  | `(len(COIL:COIL_SIGNALS), SIZES.N_COIL)` | float64 | dimensionless | Maps PCS signals to PF coil currents before the fit: coil_current = coil_signal @ MATRIX |

### `PRESHOT.INITIAL`

State before the first call.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.INITIAL:PSI_NORM` |  | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | float64 | dimensionless | psi_norm at the first call |
| `PRESHOT.INITIAL:MASK` |  | `(SIZES.N_GRID)` | int32 | dimensionless | Plasma mask at the first call |

### `PRESHOT.INFO`

Provenance.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRESHOT.INFO:SETTINGS` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | Archived JSON settings that produced the preshot |
| `PRESHOT.INFO:MU0` |  | scalar | float64 | henry / metre | Permeability used for the current basis |
| `PRESHOT.INFO:PSI_TO_WB` |  | scalar | float64 | dimensionless | Native-to-weber factor; 1 for all new preshots, 2 pi only for legacy analytic Wb/rad archives |
| `PRESHOT.INFO:SOURCE` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | Database reader and code version that produced the preshot |

## Results

### `(run node)`

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `:TIME` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | second | Time of each call to rtgsfit() |

### `GLOBAL`

0D parameters of the equilibrium.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GLOBAL:IP` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | ampere | Plasma current |
| `GLOBAL:AREA` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre ** 2 | Poloidal cross-sectional area from the boundary polygon |
| `GLOBAL:VOLUME` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre ** 3 | Axisymmetric volume enclosed by the boundary polygon |
| `GLOBAL:LENGTH_POL` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Poloidal boundary perimeter |
| `GLOBAL:PSI_MAG_AXIS` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | weber | Poloidal flux at the magnetic axis |
| `GLOBAL:XPT_DIVERTED` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | int32 | dimensionless | Flag for x-point diverted; 1=diverted; 0=limited |
| `GLOBAL:STATUS` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | int32 | dimensionless | rtgsfit() status bits; 0 is success; see the manual |

### `GLOBAL.MAG_AXIS`

Magnetic axis.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GLOBAL.MAG_AXIS:R` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Major radius of the magnetic axis |
| `GLOBAL.MAG_AXIS:Z` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Height of the magnetic axis |

### `GLOBAL.CURRENT_CENT`

Current centroid.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GLOBAL.CURRENT_CENT:R` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Major radius of the current centroid, integral(j_phi R dS) / Ip |
| `GLOBAL.CURRENT_CENT:Z` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Height of the current centroid, integral(j_phi Z dS) / Ip |

Plasma boundary.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BOUNDARY:MINOR_RADIUS` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | (R_max - R_min) / 2 of the boundary outline |

| `BOUNDARY.BOUNDING:Z` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | metre | Height of the active x-point if diverted, else of the limiter point; post-processed |

### `FIT`

The least-squares fit.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FIT:DOF_VALUES` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_FIT_DOF)` | float64 | mixed | Fitted DOF values in physical units (see DOF_UNITS), not weighted; fit_matrix fit_dof approximates fit_target |
| `FIT:DOF_NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_DOF)` | str | dimensionless | Names of the entries of fit_dof |
| `FIT:DOF_UNITS` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_DOF)` | str | dimensionless | Physical units of each fitted plasma or passive DOF |
| `FIT:TARGET_NAMES` |  | `(SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | str | dimensionless | Magnetic constraint rows followed by regularisation rows |
| `FIT:TARGET` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | float64 | dimensionless | Weighted measured constraints minus coil response; zero for regularisation rows |
| `FIT:PREDICTION` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | float64 | dimensionless | Weighted reconstructed response including regularisation rows |
| `FIT:RESIDUAL` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | float64 | dimensionless | PREDICTION minus TARGET; NaN on failed slices |
| `FIT:CHI_SQ` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_FIT_TARGET)` | float64 | dimensionless | Per-row squared weighted fit residual |
| `FIT:FF_PRIME` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | float64 | tesla | FF-prime model amplitude: mu0 times FF_PRIME_MU0 coefficient; native convention |

### `INPUT`

Inputs and settings.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INPUT:SCHEMA` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | Result schema and flux normalization contract |
| `INPUT:COCOS` |  | scalar | int32 | dimensionless | COCOS convention of exported equilibrium fields and flux |

### `FIT`

The least-squares fit.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FIT:LAPACK_INFO` |  | `(len(:TIME))` | int32 | dimensionless | INFO returned by LAPACK dgelss; 0 is success |

### `INPUT`

Inputs and settings.

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INPUT:SETTINGS` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | Validated effective JSON settings of the replay |
| `INPUT:PRESHOT_SRC` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | Where the preshot was read from |
| `INPUT:CODE_VERSION` |  | scalar | str | dimensionless | RT-GSFit version |
| `INPUT:MAG_SIGNAL` |  | `(len(:TIME), SIZES.N_MAG_SIGNAL)` | float64 | mixed | PCS inputs in PRESHOT.CONSTRAINT:MAG_SIGNALS order |
| `INPUT:COIL_SIGNAL` |  | `(len(:TIME), len(COIL:COIL_SIGNALS))` | float64 | ampere | PCS coil signals; coil_current = coil_signal @ PRESHOT.COIL:MATRIX |

### `TIMING`

Execution time of rtgsfit().

| Node | C name | Shape | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TIMING:SECTIONS` |  | `(len(TIMING:SECTIONS))` | str | dimensionless | Names of the timed sections of rtgsfit() |
| `TIMING:DURATION` |  | `(len(:TIME), len(TIMING:SECTIONS))` | float64 | second | Thread CPU time of each section; zero unless built with TIMING=1 |
